# Assessment Overview

This index links to supplementary architecture and design facts generated for this assessment.

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md) - High-level and component-level architecture diagrams with stack summary.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md) - Dependency inventory grouped by functional categories and test dependencies.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md) - Service catalog, endpoint inventory, and communication contracts.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md) - Database configuration, entity model ER diagram, repositories, and data boundaries.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md) - Profiles, properties, startup dependencies, and secrets/config inventory.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md) - Primary domain workflows, data flows, and business-rule sequence diagrams.
